information:
This competition is on a Friday evening and Saturday, and will only feature Side Events and Blind Events. As a result, this competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the many [other competitions happening in Ohio](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).
